name: Differential change review with git history
description: Review what a change INTRODUCES relative to its own history, so a vulnerability that exists only because of the delta is not normalised away by a whole-file read. The review surface is the THREE-DOT diff (base...head): a two-dot diff folds in working-tree noise, which is how an untracked credential file appears to be 'in the PR' when it is not, and a stale branch turns the surface into a mass deletion.

base_ref.description: The merge base side, e.g. origin/main

threat_context.description: Which class the reviewer weights first

allow_degrade_on_missing_history.description: A shallow clone degrades this to a history-blind read, which must be SAID

differential-reviewer.description: Security reviewer with history access; judges the delta, not the file

surface-auditor.description: Computes and certifies the review surface before any reading starts

surface-discipline.expression: diff_form == THREE_DOT AND working_tree_noise_included == false AND deletions_from_staleness == 0

work_unit.title: Compute and certify the three-dot review surface for the change
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit the file and hunk list for base...head (three dots), together with the counts that prove it is not a stale-branch mass deletion and not polluted by working-tree noise.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the surface decides everything downstream, so it is not delegated to a cheap model

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the exact git command and its output are recorded, and the two-dot and three-dot surfaces are both counted so the difference is visible
tests_required: both-states control: on a deliberately stale branch the two-dot surface must exceed the three-dot surface, and the gate must fail the two-dot form
a forward-only branch must produce identical two-dot and three-dot file lists
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the surface-discipline gate is mechanical; no human sign-off is required to reject a two-dot surface
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5001 emitted only when the surface is the three-dot form, carries a per-file add/modify/delete classification, and records both surface sizes; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5001 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to fetching the base ref explicitly before a third attempt
work_unit.mechanism: git diff base...head with an explicit two-dot control measurement
work_unit.notes: Windows note: pass git revisions with forward slashes and never as backslash paths, and scope MSYS_NO_PATHCONV to revision arguments only.

stages.title: Reject a two-dot review surface before anyone reads it
Load blame and log for each touched region
A shallow clone degrades this review and must say so
Introduced risk blocks; pre-existing risk is reported separately

work_unit.title: Partition findings into delta-introduced and pre-existing, with the reason each landed where it did
work_unit.question_or_target: For every finding, decide from the loaded history whether the delta CAUSED it or merely touched a region where it already lived, and record the blame evidence for that decision. Pre-existing risk is reported, never used to block this PR.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the partition decides what blocks a merge, so it gets the strong model

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each finding cites the commit or blame line that places it on one side of the partition
tests_required: a change that REMOVES a validation must be classed introduced even though the resulting file looks self-consistent
both-states control: a finding in an untouched region must be classed pre-existing, and must not block
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer spot-checks five partition decisions against blame output
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5002 emitted only when every finding carries an introduced flag with its blame evidence, and no pre-existing finding is marked blocking; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5002 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to reporting the whole set as UNPARTITIONED and say so
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the split-role panel has no history access at all, so it cannot make this partition and does not attempt it

stages.title: No unflagged finding, no pre-existing blocker
Emit the differential verdict only after the surface and partition gates pass

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the repo plus writes under command-center/review/**

x_extensions.licence_obligation: The differential-review source pack is CC BY-SA 4.0 (Trail of Bits). Attribution is recorded in lineage.derived_from and must travel with any redistribution.
x_extensions.mechanism: Certify a three-dot surface, load blame per touched region, then classify each finding by whether the DELTA caused it. The partition, not the finding list, is the product.
contraindications: NOT for greenfield code with no history - there is no delta to be differential about
NOT a substitute for a full audit of pre-existing code: it reviews the delta by design
NOT usable on a shallow clone without degrading to a history-blind read and saying so

benchmark_cases.name: removed-validation
benchmark_cases.setup: a commit that deletes an input check
benchmark_cases.expected: flagged as INTRODUCED even though the post-change file reads as internally consistent

benchmark_cases.name: stale-branch-surface
benchmark_cases.expected: the three-dot rule keeps the surface small; a two-dot surface proposing mass deletion must be REJECTED by surface-discipline

x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate: BP-CRV-01 is role-partitioned and history-blind; this is single-reviewer, history-aware and delta-scoped, and its output is a partition rather than a ranked list.
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED (likely) that the three-dot attachment changes the verdict on this estate's real branches; settling experiment = run both diff forms on a stale branch and compare surface size. The measured precedent is 1,188 files / 316,222 deletions under the wrong form versus 7 files / 4 deletions under the right one.

worked_example.name: review a parser change on a branch 40 commits behind base
worked_example.narrative: The two-dot surface listed 611 files; the three-dot surface listed 9. surface-discipline accepted only the three-dot form. Blame showed one deleted length check dating to the original commit, so that finding is INTRODUCED and blocking; one pre-existing unsafe join in an untouched region is reported and does not block.

negative_control.why: the measured stale-branch failure mode must be rejected by the gate, not merely noted in prose
